notes:
Snapshot: Axion PulseWare is a fintech analytics company (real-time trade signals + news ranking). Evaluation focused on lowering per-decision cost while maintaining sub-100ms tail latency for inference used in trading heuristics.

Highlights / ask summary:
- Primary workload: reranking + embeddings for market news + short chat assistant for traders.
- Hard latency target: p95 <= 80ms for 512-token-ish RL rerank operations; ideally p95 < 60ms for short chat (system messages + prompt ~120 tokens).
- Throughput: steady ~150-250 QPS during market hours; spiky bursts up to 600 QPS for rerank requests.
- Cost sensitivity: goal to reduce per-1k-token cost by 3-4x vs current hosted vendor.
- Strong interest in Redwood Optimize recommendations: batching profiles, prefix/KV caching, and quantization tradeoffs (4-bit vs 8-bit).
- Security: must run in VPC/private deployment with KMS-managed keys, have audit logs retained 1 year, and sign ISO/SOC docs.

POC / technical asks given on 2025-11-05 demo call:
- Provide benchmark matrix with: model variants (base vs quantized q4, q8), batch sizes (1,4,8,16), KV cache enabled/disabled, and sequence lengths (128,512,1024).
- Run p50/p95/p99 latency + token/sec cost for each cell; include GPU spec and kernel selection details.
- Repro script requested (docker + runbook) so their infra team can validate runs offline.
- Validate quality regression for 4-bit quantization using their internal eval set (sampled rerank queries).
- Ask: "We can't afford >100ms p95 during open — need confidence in degradation curves when batching and quantizing."

Internal notes / observations:
- SE Ethan suggested Dedicated 4xA100-style pool for initial POC; customer prefers to test in Private (VPC) with Redwood control plane.
- Procurement flagged SLA language around fallbacks; wants explicit fallback chain (dedicated -> hosted) and per-request routing policy.
- They will run parallel baseline with current vendor for cost and latency delta.

Next actions (short):
- Redwood: deliver POC benchmark matrix + reproducible run script by 2025-12-05.
- Security: share SOC2/ISO27001 attestation + sample audit log schema (link to drive doc).
- SE: prepare quantization quality report using their rerank eval set (due 2025-12-10).

Sticking points:
- Quantization quality: trading desk owners worried about subtle ranking shifts — want per-query diffs and A/B test plan.
- Benchmark reproducibility: must run identical harness in their VPC; need clear env specs and kernel/cudnn/cuBLAS versions.
- Procurement: legal wants explicit uptime and rollback clauses for Dedicated/Private contracts.
